decode_and_random_crop_v4: decode JPEG bytes and apply random crop with configurable area and aspect ratio ranges then resize
decode_and_center_crop: decode JPEG bytes and apply center crop with padding then resize to target image size
normalize_image: normalize an image tensor by subtracting ImageNet mean RGB and dividing by ImageNet standard deviation RGB
get_rand_crop_window: compute a random crop window with given width and height offsets within the image bounds
get_center_crop_window: compute a padded center crop window for a given image shape and target size
